description.content:
Adds an Ashby user to the hiring team at the application or job-level. 

**Requires the [`organizationWrite`](authentication#permissions-hiringteamaddmember) permission.**

Hiring team members can be added to a hiring team at the application, job, or opening level.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

Removes an Ashby user from the hiring team at the application or job-level. 

**Requires the [`organizationWrite`](authentication#permissions-hiringteamremovemember) permission.**

Hiring team members can be removed from a hiring team at the application, job, or opening level.
